title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.23990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context

translated_title: SCAFFOLD：面向可复用LLM智能体技能的凭证保全式证据迁移
translated_abstract: 昨天运行成功的智能体技能，今天或许仍可执行，但这并不意味着今天复用它就是有充分依据的。测试可能仅覆盖可观测的契约条款，结果判定基准可能缺失，评估可能继承了同样错误的规格说明，且权限或依赖关系可能在验证与调用之间发生变化。我们主张，前瞻性信任的恰当单元是“有保证的复用声明”（Warranted Reuse Claim, WRC）：一种可废止的、针对特定声明的授权，它与版本化的技能、目标上下文、证据、假设以及已识别的废止因素相绑定。本文通过“凭证保全式证据迁移”（Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport, WPET）来强化这一立场，这是一种用于判定哪些历史证据在上下文发生变化后仍然可采信的规范规程。该规程将证据的可采信性与所支持的安全性或有效性声明的真实性区分开来；给出一个条件性的保全结果及其局限；并规定了三值适用性与非对称上下文……
tldr: 本文提出以有保证的复用声明（WRC）和凭证保全式证据迁移（WPET）作为规范框架，用于判定历史证据在上下文变化后是否仍可采信，从而为LLM智能体技能的复用建立前瞻性信任。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Warranted Reuse Claims (WRC) and Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET) as a principled discipline for determining which historical evidence remains admissible after context change, establishing prospective trust for reusing LLM-agent skills.
